boards.title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Fresno, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning campus landmarks, finding student spaces, moving around, and adding one scheduled activity.

cards.entity_name: Lynda and Stewart Resnick Student Union
cards.title: Start at the Resnick Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon orientation point
cards.notes: Enter through the northwest side, locate the Welcome Center, and use the union as your reference point for the weekend.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a recognizable student hub and establish your campus bearings.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State identifies the Resnick Student Union as a student-union facility and places the Welcome Center in room 123 by the northwest entrance.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Friday hours of 7 a.m.–8 p.m. and Saturday hours of 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; it lists Sunday as closed. Holiday exceptions apply.

cards.title: Pause in the Peace Garden
cards.subtitle: Friday reflection north of the Library
cards.notes: Walk north of the Library, identify the memorials, and take a quiet pause before continuing through central campus.
cards.short_summary: Use a documented reflection space to slow the pace of the first afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State states that the Peace Garden is north of the Library and is intended for reflection, contemplation, and peaceful dialogue.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; the cited page does not publish visiting hours. Follow posted restrictions and avoid scheduled gatherings.

cards.title: Learn the Library Layout
cards.subtitle: Friday academic-resource stop
cards.notes: Find the service points and study floors now, then bookmark the live hours page before planning a return visit.
cards.short_summary: Turn the Library from an unfamiliar building into a usable weekend reference point.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library publishes a dedicated live page for normal hours, holidays, exceptions, and continuously available online resources.
cards.access_notes: Consult the live hours page for the specific weekend because normal hours, holidays, and other exceptions are maintained there.

cards.title: Visit the Armenian Genocide Monument
cards.subtitle: Friday walk through Maple Mall
cards.notes: Approach from Maple Mall, read the monument respectfully, and leave the central area clear for ceremonies or visitors.
cards.short_summary: Connect a prominent campus landmark with Fresno State’s documented Armenian history.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Armenian Studies Program says the monument sits on Maple Mall and was unveiled on April 23, 2015.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial; no general visiting hours are stated on the cited page. Be mindful of commemorations and organized events.

cards.title: Move at the Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning activity block
cards.notes: Bring your campus identification, confirm eligibility at the desk, and choose equipment or an activity suited to your experience.
cards.short_summary: Give Saturday an active start inside a named campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Recreation Center page lists semester operating hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday and noon–9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Semester hours list Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday noon–9 p.m. Break and summer schedules differ; confirm access eligibility.

cards.entity_name: Rue and Gwen Gibson Farm Market
cards.title: Browse the Gibson Farm Market
cards.subtitle: Saturday campus-farm stop
cards.notes: Walk to the Chestnut Avenue storefront, browse student-produced goods, and check seasonal availability before choosing anything.
cards.short_summary: See how the university’s agricultural laboratory connects student work with a public storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State says the Gibson Farm Market at 5368 N. Chestnut Avenue carries more than 100 products produced by students on campus.
cards.source_title: Rue and Gwen Gibson Farm Market
cards.access_notes: The official page lists summer Saturday hours of 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; fall/winter Saturday hours are 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Sunday hours vary by season.

cards.title: Reset in the Bulldog Zone
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon student-space stop
cards.notes: Head to the USU Pavilion, note the nearby services, and use the indoor space as a regrouping point before bowling.
cards.short_summary: Add an easy indoor pause inside the established University Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State locates the Bulldog Zone in the University Student Union Pavilion and publishes Monday-through-Saturday operating hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Bulldog Zone hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday through Saturday and identifies its location as the USU lower level.

cards.title: Play a Game at Bulldog Bowl
cards.subtitle: Saturday social activity in the USU
cards.notes: Call ahead for lane availability, bring the identification requested by the facility, and confirm current charges before playing.
cards.short_summary: Use the campus bowling alley for a structured, under-21-safe group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State identifies Bulldog Bowl as the on-campus bowling alley, open to the public, with bowling and billiards available for payment.
cards.access_notes: The current Student Unions hours page lists Monday–Saturday service from 10 a.m.–10 p.m. and says to call ahead for availability.

cards.title: Share a Meal at the Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening meal stop
cards.notes: Check the current dining schedule first, then meet at the entrance and review payment or meal-plan options before entering.
cards.short_summary: Anchor the evening with a straightforward campus meal rather than an uncertain off-campus plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State Dining lists the University Dining Hall as a campus dining location and publishes Saturday and Sunday service hours.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation - University Dining Services
cards.access_notes: The cited dining page lists weekend service, but hours are subject to change; verify the active semester schedule before going.

cards.title: Finish with a Planetarium Show
cards.subtitle: Scheduled Friday or Saturday finale
cards.notes: Check the active show calendar early, reserve or buy admission as directed, and arrive before the listed program time.
cards.short_summary: Close the sequence with a recurring public science program when the calendar aligns.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State says Downing Planetarium presents public programs one weekend per month, on Friday evenings and Saturday afternoons.
cards.access_notes: Programs occur only on selected weekends. Consult the current-shows page for dates, availability, admission details, and seasonal closures.
